findings.frozenAcceptance: Una consulta de auditoría deja Auth, Firestore, HR y Storage sin cambios; cada reconciliación autorizada emite recibo por sistema y entidad.
findings.cause: GET observation may call buildSnapshot -> refreshSnapshot -> scheduleDurableReconciliation -> shopper and operational reconcileSnapshot. format=meta and writes:false metadata do not prevent reconciliation.
findings.currentBehavior: The in-memory reproduction invokes the durable scheduler once. Real provider writes were not executed or measured by this reproduction.
minimalCompleteRepair: Remove writer scheduling from every HR observation refresh while preserving fresh source reads.
Use the existing /v1/cxorbia/commands transport for explicit hr.snapshot.reconcile; no new endpoint, provider or workflow.
Verify token principal, staff super/admin authority, tenant/project membership, expected source revision and body idempotencyKey before application writes.
Keep automatic shopper and visit upsert inside the authorized writer; connect the existing source sync-request action instead of login, watcher or audit GET.
Reuse durable commandReceipts and scoped execution leases; preserve confirmed partial progress and revalidate the actor on replay.
Report effects and ACK/readback per entity and Auth/Firestore system. Existing providerWrites counters are not exhaustive; there is no global Auth/Firestore transaction.
requiredTests: Cold, expired, fresh, metadata, JSON and protected observation paths invoke zero application writers, including authentication rejection.
Authorized explicit reconciliation retains automatic idempotent shopper/visit upsert.
Unauthorized, wrong scope, revision conflict and key reuse with changed material command perform no application writes.
Replay, concurrent replicas and interrupted partial execution preserve receipts and avoid duplicate logical entities.
Per-system/entity receipts disclose actual effects, pending/uncertain outcomes and readback without credentials.

findings.frozenAcceptance: No hay estado parcial ni resultado de una sesión anterior aplicado a la nueva. Login, cambio de rol y actualización no requieren recargar manualmente.
findings.cause: The refresh wrapper schedules composition and returns. applyComposition mutates CX.data before final readiness; reconcile applies the live snapshot before full principal/revision validation.
minimalCompleteRepair: Prepare HR and Firestore snapshots off CX.data using existing mappers/composer; do not emit partial ready events.
Capture an attempt ticket with session generation, UID, role, namespace, shopper, tenant, project and revision; validate after asynchronous boundaries and before commit.
Invalidate generations for logout/relogin, including A-to-B-to-A with the same UID. Reject stale completion and stale error publication.
Validate principal/profile/country and collection invariants on prepared state; publish fields synchronously while retaining CX.data object identity.
Make refresh/reconcile callers await committed composition and its readback; watcher advances revision only after a valid applied result.
Bind readiness to the complete current principal and revision for all roles; preserve A04 identity equivalence and approved zero-assignment access.
requiredTests: Rejected profile/country leaves prior visible data and session unchanged.
Old-session completion or rejection cannot mutate or block the new session; include same-UID new generation and role/project changes.
Concurrent refresh promises settle only for their valid applied revision.
Observers see one complete state and retain CX.data object identity.
Cold/warm login, slow network, changed source revision and authorized shopper with zero assignments work without manual reload.

results.observation: Read refresh invokes durable reconciliation scheduler
Refresh resolves with reconciliation still pending
Readiness rejection occurs after replacement of visible visits and profile

reproductions.usage: Extract script to a temporary .cjs file and run: node <script.cjs> <checkout-of-productSourceSha>. Exact input Git blobs are checked before isolated execution.
reproductions.limitation: Synthetic source reproductions only: no live provider calls, DEV mutation measurement, repaired behavior, concurrency closure or user acceptance.

nextExactAction: Start G05 with a fresh canonical HEAD/tree readback and owner allowlist. Add red tests for safe observation and the authorized writer, implement the smallest complete correction preserving automatic upsert and truthful receipts, then run focal source QA. Proceed to A05 on the same serial branch. Do not invoke refresh-dependent real DEV proof until these conditions are met.
authorizationBoundary: Existing I3 technical scope only; no I4 authorization. Future real application writes remain limited to expressly permitted DEV scope and gates.
